subject: prd/installer
statement: When init runs in an empty target — a directory holding no tracked content; where no git repository exists, init shall initialize one — it shall seed the governed-document skeletons the gates require, the empty-but-valid registries and taxonomy directories, and no governing content beyond template structure and guidance.
rationale: green-on-install without counterfeit governance; one command from nothing (D-4)
fit_criterion: post-init docgate passes from both a bare directory and a git-initialized empty repo; seeded skeletons contain only template-derived structure/guidance (diffed against the shipped templates)
